_source_note: Categories mirror the live site product catalog (sweepandvac.com / products.js, April 2026). Slugs match exactly so YouTube playlists align with on-site navigation. fallback_category.title: Sin Categoría

fallback_category.note: Videos assigned to this category are flagged in the diff for human review. No playlist is created — the operator must reassign these manually before pushing playlist memberships.

legacy_products._note: Some YouTube videos depict products that are no longer in the live catalog. Map them to the closest current category so videos still get organized into the right playlist for buyers searching today.

assignment_rules.notes: The agent uses these hints as a fallback only. The primary source of truth for playlist_category is Claude's output in the rewrite step. These hints are used by audit.py to flag mismatches and by playlists.py to validate assignments. Legacy products map to the closest current category — see legacy_products above.
